events.title: 45 police officers are injured when 밀월 fans riot at the end of the Division One playoff fixture against 버밍엄 시티 .
아스널 clinch the eighth FA Cup victory of their history with a 2–0 win over 첼시 at the Millennium Stadium .
Internazionale awkwardly hands over the Serie A Scudetto to their bitter rivals 유벤투스 after losing away to 라치오 , 4–2.
아스널 beat defending champions 맨체스터 유나이티드 1–0 at Old Trafford to complete their second double in five seasons.
Marlon King , 22-year-old 질링엄 striker, is jailed for 18 months for driving a stolen car.

On the final day of the Premier League season, 리버풀 beat 입스위치 타운 5–0 to confirm second place (their first top two finish since 1991). That heavy defeat meant that the Tractor Boys' were relegated and it also resulted in 맨체스터 유나이티드 being forced to settle for third place – leaving them outside the top two for the first time since 1991 and they also fail to finish winners or runners-up of a major competition for the first time since 1989. 선덜랜드 confirm their survival with a 1–1 home draw against already relegated 더비 카운티. Bottom club 레스터 시티 finish the season with only their fifth league win, beating 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–1 in their final game at Filbert Street , their home for 111 years, before relocation to the Walkers Stadium .
버밍엄 시티 win promotion to the Premier League on penalties in the Division One playoff final, while fellow promoted side 맨체스터 시티 sign 실뱅 디스탱 from 파리 생제르맹 for £4 million.

The Premier League and Football League officials announce their opposition to FIFA 's plans to operate a transfer window system which could see mid-season transfers only permitted to take place during one month of the season. A record eight black players are capped by England in the World Cup warm-up match in South Korea which ends in a 1–1 draw.
로이 킨의 사이판 대표팀 이탈 사태 — 아일랜드의 월드컵 준비 캠프에서 로이 킨과 믹 매카시 감독의 갈등이 공개적으로 폭발했다. 대회 준비와 대표팀 운영을 둘러싼 사건이다.
레스터 시티 sell Robbie Savage to 버밍엄 시티 for £1.25 million.
Football World Cup 2002 : Senegal defeats defending champion France 1–0.
